components.name: Proof Panel

Healthcare Proof

The website should feel as considered as the patient experience.

Our healthcare work includes pediatric ABA, speech-language therapy, physician, and specialty-practice websites. components.css: .ds-proof-panel { min-height: 320px; padding: clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2rem); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-proof-panel__label { margin: 0 0 1rem; color: var(--accent); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-proof-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.8rem; max-width: 18ch; color: var(--paper); font-family: var(--serif); font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 4.8rem); font-weight: 520; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 0.94; } .ds-proof-panel > p:not(.ds-proof-panel__label) { max-width: 58ch; color: oklch(84% 0.012 248); font-family: var(--sans); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-proof-panel__actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 1.25rem; } .ds-proof-panel__primary, .ds-proof-panel__secondary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.78rem 1rem; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-proof-panel__primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--accent); } .ds-proof-panel__secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--paper); border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.18); } .ds-proof-panel__primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-proof-panel__secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); } .ds-proof-panel a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The Proof Ledger treats the site as a calm, public record of the studio's work. Near-white paper, dark ink, restrained gold, editorial serif type, and real client imagery create an institutional surface that feels handcrafted and easy to verify.

Work, client context, and direct evidence should remain visually ahead of broad agency claims. Pages may choose different compositions, but they share bounded rails, crisp controls, factual labels, and a restrained hierarchy that keeps attention on the artifact and the next useful route.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence and real client work lead the visual hierarchy.
Near-white paper and dark ink carry most of the interface.
Gold acts as a restrained annotation and action color.
Editorial serif headlines pair with plain sans body copy and compact evidence labels.
Layouts stay bounded, responsive, and quiet enough for trust-first subjects.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: Gold marks labels, selected emphasis, and high-value actions. Keep it rare enough to retain meaning.

rules.name: The Serif Lead Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 carries display and section headlines. IBM Plex Sans handles explanation and controls. Geist Mono is reserved for compact facts and evidence markers.

rules.name: The Tracking Guardrail
rules.body: New or touched serif display headings stay at -0.04em or looser. Tighter values in legacy shared CSS are migration debt, not a pattern to repeat.

rules.name: The Flat at Rest Rule
rules.body: Paper tone and hairline borders define most surfaces. Use the established ambient shadows for an answer panel or an interactive lift, never as a default around every container.

dos: Do put real client imagery, project names, and verifiable routes ahead of decorative agency claims.
Do preserve the near-white, dark-ink, and restrained-gold balance.
Do keep actions at least 44px high and maintain visible focus treatment.
Do collapse multi-column grids before the content becomes compressed, and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't turn the Smitha Reddy split hero, fact band, or case-study sequence into a universal page template.
Don't use gold as a full-page field or repeated decorative effect.
Don't replace real work with stock scenes, generic device mockups, or invented outcomes.
Don't spread pill controls or large friendly radii across the editorial system.
